column1: # Consignes de dessin, un panneau par ligne.
# Ce fichier est la SUBSTANCE des planches : le style commun vit dans
# planches_ia.js, ici on décrit ce que montre chaque panneau. Une planche =
# quatre panneaux qui se suivent, comme une notice de montage.
# handle : la fiche Shopify dont la première photo sert de référence au modèle.
# C'est ce qui fait que le dessin montre le produit de Lasclay et pas un
# équivalent générique. Laisser vide pour un geste qui ne tient à aucun produit.
# Aucune consigne ne demande de texte : la planche se lit sans langue, et la
# numérotation est faite par la page, jamais par l'image.

column4: The whole tubular neck gaiter standing upright, seen from the front, the complete garment inside the frame with its drawstring and cord lock visible at the top. A thin bright red ellipse is drawn around the lower hem, marking the horizontal bottom seam that runs all the way around. Nothing else is marked. No hands in this panel.

The same whole neck gaiter, still fully in frame and still recognisable, seen from the front. Two stylised instructional hands now grip the fabric at the bottom of the garment, one pinching just ABOVE the horizontal bottom seam and the other pinching just BELOW it, so the seam line runs between the two grips. The hands are still, the fabric is relaxed, the seam is closed. No arrows in this panel.

The same whole neck gaiter, same view, same two grips on either side of the horizontal bottom seam. The hands now pull APART along the vertical axis: the upper hand pulls upward and the lower hand pulls downward, stretching the fabric across the seam line. One bold red arrow outlined in white points straight up and another points straight down, along the direction of the pull. The seam stays closed and flat under the strain.

Extreme close-up of that same horizontal bottom seam of the same grey garment, the seam running left to right across the frame, split into two halves by a thin vertical divider. On the left half the seam is flat, closed and evenly stitched, with a green check mark drawn as a plain geometric tick above it. On the right half the very same horizontal seam has pulled open along its length, the two fabric edges parted to show a gap with loose stitching thread bridging it, with a red cross drawn as two crossed bars above it. No hands in this panel.
